video_title: EXCLUSIVE Interview with 2026 NBA Finals MVP Jalen Brunson | By The Horns

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the whirlwind of winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: It's crazy. I'm not sure if I can put it into words yet, but I will at some point.
quotes.quote: It's crazy. It's crazy. I'm not sure if I can put it into words yet, but I will at some point.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the importance of giving back to the community
quotes.excerpt: I know that the kids and the youth are the future regardless of what they want to do.
quotes.quote: It's very important for me. Just because I know what the future holds. I know that the kids and the youth are the future regardless of what they want to do, whether it's sports, whether it's anything outside of sports. One thing that's important that I try to drive home here is that you can obviously learn a decent amount of skills or the beginning of working on different things, but I just drive home hard work, confidence, work ethic. Those things I think translate to not just basketball and sports, but to life.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his connection to his hometown and past teams
quotes.excerpt: It was always important to go back wherever I laid, wherever I stepped foot.
quotes.quote: It was always important to go back wherever I laid, wherever I stepped foot. Illinois, here, even Dallas and obviously New York. Those places mean a lot to me. They helped me grow every step of the way. This place definitely holds a special place in my heart, and so it's really important that I've made this one really consistent.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his mother's role in his foundation
quotes.excerpt: I may be the face, but she's the gears behind everything.
quotes.quote: My foundation, Second Round Foundation, was founded by me, but Sandra Brunson, my mother, really runs that. She's the gears behind everything. She makes sure everything runs so smoothly, the way we do everything. It's really important for us because, like I said, no matter what, we want to get back, and giving back to the kids, giving back to the youth through school and sports. I told you about the mindset that kids have and everything, and that stems from the foundation's goal.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on staying grounded despite the hype
quotes.excerpt: I think no matter what, I was able to stay grounded because of my family.
quotes.quote: I think no matter what, I was able to stay grounded because of my family and the close circle I have. I was never really satisfied throughout my time in high school, obviously because we were losing, and I wanted to win a state championship. Most importantly, obviously there are a lot of individual accolades out there, but I think when you win, that's what's most memorable.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on defining pressure through his father's career
quotes.excerpt: Watching my dad work out the way he did for about eight or nine years on non-guaranteed contracts.
quotes.quote: Watching my dad work out the way he did for about eight or nine years on non-guaranteed contracts, not really knowing when he's going to be picked up, when he's going to get cut, if he's going to play at all, he was finding ways to push himself. I didn't know at the time, I think as I go older I figured it out, but just knowing that now and then remembering him running on the track while I'm riding my bike, or watching him go shoot and lift and then maybe go play to get some more extra cardio, just see him do that day and day and day, and him running outside with like the trash bag, he was finding ways to push himself. Everything kind of came flooding back when I realized it was time for me to get better and time for me to improve myself.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his development at Villanova
quotes.excerpt: I played a lot of different roles at Nova. My freshman year, I had to be a star.
quotes.quote: I played a lot of different roles at Nova. My freshman year, I had to be a star in my role. I was more of a role player. I was like the go-to guy, kind of backed down the totem pole, but I worked my way into being able to start. Individually, maybe it wasn't what I wanted as a player, but I knew that if I started my role, everything was going to fall in place. I was able to help my team win behind Arch and Josh and Jay Wright. It was a great, great, it was great for me.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on learning from Luka Doncic and the Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: They were giving Luka the keys to run the show, and I got to see a lot.
quotes.quote: They were giving Luka the keys to run the show, and I got to see a lot. I got to learn a lot. I got to understand a lot. I kept getting better and better, and you fast forward to my fourth year, and then being able to thrive under J-Kidd made me a lot better as well. It was a great, great, it was great for me. I thought I would be there in the beginning for a long time, but I think that whole situation there, I got to learn from Luka, I got to learn from Rick Carlisle and J-Kidd, and I'm really thankful. They brought me to the NBA, they allowed me to be me, and I learned, I got better every single year.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the energy of New York fans
quotes.excerpt: I really believe that the energy of the fans, no matter what was said prior.
quotes.quote: I really believe that the energy of the fans, no matter what was said prior to me stepping on the court and actually playing, it's whatever. Once I started playing, I feel comfortable. I feel like I'm at peace, I'm at home when I'm on that court, and so I didn't even care what people said. I just knew that if once I got the opportunity to go out there and play, I was just going to be myself. I wasn't going to try and show the world that I belonged. I was just trying to prove myself, prove to myself that I belonged in this situation and I can handle it.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on embracing the pressure of New York
quotes.excerpt: I embraced it. I embraced everything that went along with it.
quotes.quote: I embraced it. I embraced everything that went along with it. Yeah, it's the heaviest jersey to wear with New York across your chest, but I think when you're genuine and you're accountable, you know what, I didn't play well, but you know what, I'm going to turn around, I'm going to do whatever, and then your actions match your words, I think the fans and the people who love the Knicks can really get behind that and cheer for that. I just try to be as genuine as possible. I try to say the right things, try to just be myself, I'm not trying to be anything different than myself.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the chemistry with his Villanova teammates
quotes.excerpt: We never really talked about us being able to do this now and comparing it to Nova.
quotes.quote: We never really talked about us being able to do this now and comparing it to Nova. We never really talked about Villanova like that. I think which made it special because we understand what we did, but this is something new for us to try and achieve, and to be able to do that with those guys, it meant a lot for sure.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's mindset during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: We just kept chipping away, and what I mean by that is throughout the entire year.
quotes.quote: For us, I feel like we just kept chipping away. And what I mean by that is throughout the entire year, everyone says, you guys are playing great right now or you guys are playing terrible right now, like there's highs and lows of the season, but as a team, we want to be playing the best that we can by the end of the year. So we just kept chipping away, getting better, chipping away, finding ways to get better every single day. That was just our mindset. When it came to us doing what we did, yeah, it seems like, yeah, we were just playing out of this world, but we just kept chipping away, chipping away. Everything was zero-zero. We weren't thinking about the next game, we were focusing on the moment. And the moment we did, think about the next game, we were game two of the Sixers series and game one of the Eastern Conference Finals, yeah, it just wasn't how we wanted to play, but we all put each other accountable, we all understand what we wanted to do, so it was a quick fix because we know what our goals were and we know that we were just doing whatever it took and we had no egos, and nothing needed to be said, nothing needed to be argued about, it just needed to be said and then we were back, we were back in clicking. So we just kept finding a way, that was our motto, just find a way.
